info.title: MICROSERVICE-batchinsertion-List Realestate Listings Agents-v2-spec
info.description: The Real Estate Listings by Agent API provides access to a curated list of real estate listings associated with specific agents. This endpoint allows users to retrieve detailed information about available properties, including key attributes such as location, price, and agent details. Typically consumed by real estate platforms, market analysts, and agents themselves, the API supports various use cases, like property searches and market assessments. By leveraging this API, users can effectively track real estate offerings and make informed decisions.

get.summary: Retrieve listings associated with a specific agent.
get.description: This endpoint allows you to fetch all the property listings that are managed by a specific agent. It helps users to view properties that a particular real estate agent has listed, providing relevant details for potential buyers or renters.
